clauses.scope_note: CC BY 4.0 §3(a)(1), Licensed Material. Sharing, including sharing in modified form, triggers the attribution conditions set out in §3(a)(1)(A)–(C); specific duties are represented by the applicable existing clauses.
clauses.condition_explanation: sharing_licensed_material_including_modified_form means the licensee Shares Licensed Material, whether or not modified. The condition requires the applicable attribution duties detailed in the existing clauses for lines 220–244; those duties include prerequisites and are not all unconditional.

obligation_items.content: Comply with the applicable attribution conditions in Section 3(a)(1) when sharing Licensed Material, including in modified form.
obligation_items.object: Licensed Material and applicable attribution information
obligation_items.trigger: When You Share the Licensed Material, including in modified form; each specific retention duty applies only under its stated conditions.

coverage_notes: Section 4(a) additionally states rights to extract and reuse database contents. Neither action has a faithful match in the allowed activity vocabulary; reproduction and sharing are covered by the immutable clauses.

Section 4(b)'s classification of the receiving database as Adapted Material, but not its individual contents, is a legal-status consequence rather than an action permission or prohibition; it cannot be represented faithfully with the allowed activities and modalities.
Section 4(c)'s reference to Section 3(a) is locally interpretable using the full original, including the attribution conditions at lines 217–259.

paragraph_audit.reason: Lines 217–218 make sharing Licensed Material, including in modified form, subject to the ensuing attribution duties; the clause models that conditional duty and the existing clauses specify its applicable requirements.
Section 4(a)'s extraction and reuse rights have no faithful allowed activity. Its reproduction and sharing rights are covered by the cited immutable clauses.
Section 4(b) states a classification consequence for the receiving database, not a permission or prohibition for an allowed action; no faithful activity representation exists.

Section 4(c) requires compliance with Section 3(a) when sharing all or a substantial portion of database contents. The full original supplies the referenced conditions at lines 217–259, and the cited clause represents the cross-referenced duty.
